title: Normalized ordinary etale system operations exist
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $c=(j:X\to Z,p:Z\to Y)$ a compactification, so $j$ is open and $p$ is proper. Fix $\ell\in\mathbf N$. On the vertical sequence site of each small etale site, use strict module systems over every inverse sequence of finite commutative rings annihilated levelwise by powers of $\ell$. The normalized operations record $\operatorname{Theory}(c,\ell)$ of [def-pur-etale-system-projection-data] is inhabited: its proper direct image is the actual sequence-site module direct image, its inverse image and open extension are their exact adjoints, its scalar functors use the published derived scalar model, and all restriction and evaluation comparisons have the section and mate normalizations in that record.
